Package jmt.common

package jmt.common
Common classes shared by the JMT engine, including network constants, common exceptions and XML element definitions.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    jmt.common.exception
    Exceptions shared by the JMT engine, such as the load exception raised when a closed workload exceeds the capacity of the network.
    jmt.common.xml
    XML constants for the JMT model file format, shared between the engine and the file handling layer.
  • Class
    Description
    AsyncWarning
    Shows an engine warning from a separate thread after a short delay, so the GUI is up before the popup appears.
    AutoCheck
    This interface should be implemented by all the classes which should implement an auto-check method.
    ConnectionCheck
    Checks the validity of the connections of a JSIMgraph model.
    ErrorReporter
    Sink for user-facing warnings and errors, so the engine need not depend on a GUI.
    ErrorReporters
    Global holder of the active ErrorReporter; GUIs install their own at startup.
    GlobalSettings
    Global settings of JMT, read from the globalsettings configuration file.
    LoggingErrorReporter
    Default ErrorReporter: writes to the SLF4J log, safe in headless JVMs.
    MD5Checksum
    MD5 checksum computation used by the JMT file handling.
